fix.note: Plural/uncountable measure word; after an adjective = 'a bit more': 快啲.

ex.r: di1 sung3 hou2 hou2 sik6
ex.en: The dishes are really tasty.

ex.r: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 maan6 di1 aa3
ex.en: Could you speak a bit slower?

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 saang1 gwo2
ex.en: I want to buy some fruit.

ex.r: ho2 nang4 sak1 gan2 ce1
ex.en: Kevin might be stuck in traffic.

ex.r: gam1 maan5 ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 jyu5
ex.en: It might rain tonight.

ex.r: ngo5 ho2 nang4 jiu3 gaa1 baan1
ex.en: I might have to work overtime.

fix.note: Marks the receiver; also 'let'. Also written 俾.

ex.r: m4 goi1 bei2 bui1 seoi2 ngo5
ex.en: A glass of water, please.

ex.r: ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 hai6 bei2 nei5 ge3
ex.en: This gift is for you.

ex.r: gam1 ci3 ngo5 bei2 cin2 haa6 ci3 nei5 ceng2
ex.en: I'll pay this time, you treat next time.

fix.en: to return; go back; (after verb) back
fix.note: 返工 go to work, 返學 go to school, 還返 give back.

ex.r: ngo5 baat3 dim2 faan1 gung1
ex.en: I go to work at eight.

ex.r: siu2 pang4 jau5 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 hok6
ex.en: The kids don't have school tomorrow.

ex.r: gei3 dak1 waan4 faan1 bun2 syu1 bei2 ngo5
ex.en: Remember to give my book back.

fix.note: Plural of 呢個; also for uncountables like water or food.

ex.r: ni1 di1 hai6 mat1 je5 lai4 gaa3
ex.en: What are these?

ex.r: ni1 di1 saam1 jiu3 sai2
ex.en: These clothes need washing.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 ni1 di1
ex.en: I don't like eating this stuff.

ex.s: 其實我唔係好鍾意食魚。
ex.r: kei4 sat6 ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 jyu2
ex.en: Actually, I don't really like fish.

ex.r: kei4 sat6 keoi5 jan4 gei2 hou2 gaa3
ex.en: Actually, he's quite a nice person.

ex.r: kei4 sat6 m4 sai2 gam3 zou2 ceot1 mun4
ex.en: Actually, we don't need to leave so early.

fix.note: …嘅時候 = when…; 有時候 = sometimes.

ex.s: 食飯嘅時候唔好玩手機。
ex.r: sik6 faan6 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 hou2 waan2 sau2 gei1
ex.en: Don't play on your phone while eating.

ex.s: 我細個嘅時候好鍾意游水。
ex.r: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 zung1 ji3 jau4 seoi2
ex.en: I loved swimming when I was a kid.

ex.s: 有時候我會搭的士返工。
ex.r: jau5 si4 hau6 ngo5 wui5 daap3 dik1 si2 faan1 gung1
ex.en: Sometimes I take a taxi to work.

fix.note: Very common softener; aa4 in surprised or checking questions.

ex.r: nei5 giu3 me1 meng2 aa3
ex.en: What's your name?

ex.s: 今日好凍呀，着多件衫啦。
ex.r: gam1 jat6 hou2 dung3 aa3 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1 laa1
ex.en: It's so cold today, put on another layer.

ex.r: ni1 go3 gei2 cin2 aa3
ex.en: How much is this?

fix.note: Said cin2 when it means money; 幾錢 = how much?

ex.s: 呢件衫好抵，唔使好多錢。
ex.r: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 dai2 m4 sai2 hou2 do1 cin2
ex.en: This shirt's a good deal, it doesn't cost much.

ex.r: maai4 daan1 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3
ex.en: How much is the bill?

ex.r: soeng2 cou5 cin2 maai5 lau2
ex.en: Ka-yan wants to save money to buy a flat.

fix.note: V咗…未？ = 'have you…yet?'; answer 未呀 = not yet.

ex.r: nei5 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you finished your homework yet?

ex.r: zung6 mei6 dou3
ex.en: Wing hasn't arrived yet.

ex.r: ngo5 mei6 sik6 zou2 caan1
ex.en: I haven't had breakfast yet.

fix.en: to speak; to talk; to say
fix.note: 講 + language = speak it; 同…講 = tell/talk to.

ex.r: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 faai3
ex.en: She talks really fast.

ex.r: ngo5 tung4 lou5 baan2 gong2 zo2
ex.en: I talked to the boss.

ex.r: sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2
ex.en: Kevin can speak Cantonese.

fix.note: 食緊 = eating now. Replaces Mandarin 在/正在.

ex.r: ngo5 sik6 gan2 faan6 dang2 zan6 daa2 bei2 nei5
ex.en: I'm eating, I'll call you in a bit.

ex.r: ngoi6 min6 lok6 gan2 daai6 jyu5
ex.en: It's pouring outside.

ex.r: hok6 gan2 gwong2 dung1 waa2
ex.en: Kevin is learning Cantonese.

fix.en: to be called; to order; to tell (someone)

ex.r: ngo5 giu3 nei5 ne1
ex.en: I'm Dan, and you?

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 giu3 ngoi6 maai6 laa1
ex.en: Let's order takeout.

ex.r: lou5 baan2 giu3 ngo5 ting1 jat6 zou2 di1 faan1
ex.en: The boss told me to come in earlier tomorrow.

fix.note: For tables, tickets, photos, paper: 一張相.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 loeng5 zoeng1 hei3 fei1
ex.en: I'd like two movie tickets.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 sei3 jan4 toi2
ex.en: We'd like a table for four.

ex.r: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 jing2 dak1 hou2 leng3
ex.en: This photo came out really nice.

fix.en: to not have; there isn't; didn't
fix.note: Negative of 有; replaces Mandarin 沒有. Before a verb: 'didn't'.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 go3 jyut6 mou5 mat1 cin2
ex.en: I don't have much money this month.

ex.r: syut3 gwai6 mou5 ngau4 naai5 laa3
ex.en: There's no milk left in the fridge.

ex.r: ngo5 cam4 maan5 mou5 fan3 hou2
ex.en: I didn't sleep well last night.

fix.note: Gives an obvious reason: 'after all, you know'.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 heoi3 laa3 lok6 gan2 jyu5 maa3
ex.en: I'm not going, it's raining after all.

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 gui6 zou6 zo2 jat1 jat6 je5 maa3
ex.en: He's tired, he worked all day, you know.

ex.r: peng4 di1 laa1 ngo5 maai5 loeng5 gin6 maa3
ex.en: Make it cheaper, I'm buying two after all.

fix.note: With numbers, no measure word: 三日. 今日 today.

ex.s: 今日好熱呀，記得飲多啲水。
ex.r: gam1 jat6 hou2 jit6 aa3 gei3 dak1 jam2 do1 di1 seoi2
ex.en: It's so hot today, remember to drink more water.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dung1 ging1 zyu6 zo2 ng5 jat6
ex.en: We stayed in Tokyo for five days.

ex.r: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 haang4 bun3 go3 zung1
ex.en: I walk for half an hour every day.

fix.note: 幫手 = help (out).

ex.s: 你可唔可以幫我影張相？
ex.r: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 jing2 zoeng1 soeng2
ex.en: Could you take a photo for me?

ex.r: ngo5 bong1 nei5 ling1 laa1
ex.en: Let me carry that for you.

ex.r: jau5 me1 jiu3 bong1 sau2 zau6 ceot1 seng1 laa1
ex.en: If you need any help, just say so.

fix.note: Softens requests and suggestions.

ex.r: faai3 di1 laa1 zau6 lai4 ci4 dou3 laa3
ex.en: Hurry up, we're about to be late!

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jam2 caa4 laa1
ex.en: Let's go for dim sum.

ex.s: 你坐低先啦，我好快返嚟。
ex.r: nei5 co5 dai1 sin1 laa1 ngo5 hou2 faai3 faan1 lai4
ex.en: Have a seat, I'll be right back.

fix.note: Marks something new: 'now, already'. 夠喇 = that's enough.

ex.r: sik6 faan6 laa3 faai3 di1 lai4
ex.en: Dinner's ready, come quickly!

ex.r: ngo5 baau2 laa3 m4 goi1
ex.en: I'm full now, thanks.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 zau2 laa3 ting1 jat6 gin3
ex.en: I have to go now, see you tomorrow.

fix.note: Starts a sentence: 'so/then'. Not 咁 gam3 'so (very)'.

ex.r: gam2 ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 gin3 laa1
ex.en: Then let's meet tomorrow.

ex.r: gam2 ngo5 maai5 ni1 gin6 laa1
ex.en: Then I'll buy this one.

ex.r: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 laa1
ex.en: Don't talk like that.

fix.note: 話 + person + 知 = tell someone. In 電話 it's waa2.

ex.r: waa6 keoi5 gam1 maan5 m4 faan1 lai4 sik6 faan6
ex.en: Mei said she won't be home for dinner tonight.

ex.r: ngo5 waa6 zo2 bei2 nei5 zi1 gaa3 laa3
ex.en: I already told you.

ex.r: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jiu3 jau1 sik1 gei2 jat6
ex.en: The doctor said I need to rest a few days.

fix.en: to do; to make; to work
fix.note: 做嘢 = to work.

ex.r: nei5 gam1 maan5 zou6 me1 aa3
ex.en: What are you doing tonight?

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 ji1 jyun2 zou6 je5
ex.en: I work at a hospital.

ex.r: ngo5 maa4 maa1 hou2 zung1 ji3 zou6 daan6 gou1
ex.en: My mom loves making cakes.

fix.note: After a verb: 食多啲 = eat more.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 zou6
ex.en: I have lots to do today.

ex.r: nei5 jiu3 sik6 do1 di1 coi3
ex.en: You need to eat more vegetables.

ex.r: go2 dou6 do1 m4 do1 jan4 aa3
ex.en: Is it crowded there?

ex.r: ngo5 zi6 gei2 lai4 dak1 laa3 m4 goi1
ex.en: I can do it myself, thanks.

ex.r: nei5 jiu3 ziu3 gu3 hou2 zi6 gei2
ex.en: Take good care of yourself.

ex.r: keoi5 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 jan4 zyu6
ex.en: She lives by herself.

fix.note: Joins nouns or adds a point. Mandarin 和.

ex.s: 我要一個菠蘿包同埋一杯奶茶。
ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 jat1 go3 bo1 lo4 baau1 tung4 maai4 jat1 bui1 naai5 caa4
ex.en: I'd like a pineapple bun and a milk tea.

ex.r: gei3 dak1 daai3 ngan4 baau1 tung4 maai4 so2 si4
ex.en: Remember to bring your wallet and keys.

ex.s: 佢識講英文同埋廣東話。
ex.r: keoi5 sik1 gong2 jing1 man2 tung4 maai4 gwong2 dung1 waa2
ex.en: She speaks English and Cantonese.

fix.en: at that time; back then; when
fix.note: Often shortened to 嗰陣.

ex.s: 我細個嗰陣時住喺九龍。
ex.r: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 zyu6 hai2 gau2 lung4
ex.en: When I was little I lived in Kowloon.

ex.r: go2 zan6 si4 ngo5 zung6 duk6 gan2 daai6 hok6
ex.en: Back then I was still in university.

ex.s: 我打俾你嗰陣時，你喺邊呀？
ex.r: ngo5 daa2 bei2 nei5 go2 zan6 si4 nei5 hai2 bin1 aa3
ex.en: Where were you when I called you?

fix.note: 見到 = saw. For 'look at, watch' use 睇.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 luk6 gin3 laa1
ex.en: Let's meet on Saturday.

ex.r: ngo5 hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 gwo3 keoi5
ex.en: I haven't seen him for a long time.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 gin3 ji1 sang1
ex.en: I have to see the doctor tomorrow.

fix.note: 'Or' in statements; in questions use 定係.

ex.s: 你可以搭地鐵或者巴士。
ex.r: nei5 ho2 ji5 daap3 dei6 tit3 waak6 ze2 baa1 si2
ex.en: You can take the MTR or the bus.

ex.r: waak6 ze2 ngo5 dei6 goi2 jat6 zoi3 king1
ex.en: Maybe we can talk another day.

ex.s: 星期六或者星期日都得。
ex.r: sing1 kei4 luk6 waak6 ze2 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 dak1
ex.en: Saturday or Sunday are both fine.

fix.en: to go out; to come out
fix.note: 出街 = go out; 出口 = exit.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 ceot1 gaai1 sik6 faan6
ex.en: We're eating out tonight.

ex.r: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 zo2 mun4
ex.en: He just left the house.

ex.r: nei5 hai2 ceot1 hau2 dang2 ngo5
ex.en: Wait for me at Exit B.

fix.note: Colloquial 'fear' (Mandarin 怕); 唔使驚 = don't worry.

ex.r: ngo5 sai3 go3 hou2 geng1 hak1
ex.en: I was afraid of the dark as a kid.

ex.r: m4 sai2 geng1 daa2 zam1 m4 tung3 gaa3
ex.en: Don't worry, the shot doesn't hurt.

ex.r: ngo5 geng1 ci4 dou3 so2 ji5 daap3 dik1 si2
ex.en: I was worried about being late, so I took a taxi.

fix.note: Expresses discovery: 原來係你！ 'Oh, it's you!'

ex.r: jyun4 loi4 nei5 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2
ex.en: Oh, so you speak Cantonese!

ex.r: jyun4 loi4 gam1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 hok6
ex.en: It turns out there's no school today.

ex.r: jyun4 loi4 keoi5 dei6 hai6 loeng5 hing1 dai6
ex.en: Oh, so they're brothers.

fix.note: 屋企人 = family members.

ex.r: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 uk1 kei2
ex.en: I'm at home now.

ex.r: nei5 uk1 kei2 jau5 gei2 do1 go3 jan4
ex.en: How many people are in your family?

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hai2 uk1 kei2 sik6
ex.en: We're eating at home tonight.

fix.note: A month = 一個月; 五月 = May.

ex.r: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 jat6 bun2
ex.en: I'm going to Japan next month.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 mui5 go3 jyut6 gaau1 zou1
ex.en: We pay rent every month.

ex.r: keoi5 saang1 jat6 hai2 ng5 jyut6
ex.en: Her birthday is in May.

fix.en: to hit; to make (a call); to play (ball)
fix.note: 打俾 = call (someone); 打波 = play ball.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 daa2 bei2 nei5
ex.en: I'll call you tomorrow.

ex.r: ngo5 fung4 sing1 kei4 luk6 daa2 bo1
ex.en: I play ball every Saturday.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 ngan4 hong4 daa2 gung1
ex.en: She works at a bank.

fix.note: Before a verb = 'don't'.

ex.r: m4 hou2 haang4 gam3 faai3 dang2 maai4 ngo5
ex.en: Don't walk so fast, wait for me!

ex.r: m4 hou2 sik6 gam3 do1 tong2
ex.en: Don't eat so much candy.

ex.s: 今日天氣唔好，留喺屋企啦。
ex.r: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 m4 hou2 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 laa1
ex.en: The weather's bad today, stay home.

fix.note: 冇問題 = no problem.

ex.en: No problem, I'll give it to you tomorrow.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 man6 jat1 go3 man6 tai4
ex.en: I'd like to ask a question.

ex.r: ngo5 bou6 ce1 jau5 di1 man6 tai4
ex.en: My car has a bit of a problem.

ex.r: ngo5 sik1 gong2 siu2 siu2 gwong2 dung1 waa2
ex.en: I speak a little Cantonese.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 siu2 siu2 laat6 zau6 gau3
ex.en: Just a little spicy is enough for me.

ex.r: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 peng4 siu2 siu2 aa3
ex.en: Could you make it a little cheaper?

ex.r: ngo5 ji5 cin4 hai2 mei5 gwok3 duk6 syu1
ex.en: I used to study in the US.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 ji5 cin4 hai6 jat1 gaan1 hei3 jyun2
ex.en: This used to be a cinema.

ex.r: sik6 faan6 ji5 cin4 gei3 dak1 sai2 sau2
ex.en: Remember to wash your hands before eating.

notes: Content and Jyutping sound; all 59 dictionary CHECKs are correct colloquial readings (會 wui5, 聽 teng1, 間 gaan1, 平 peng4, 驚 geng1, 個女 neoi2…). Fixed four wrong pos labels and one over-specific translation.
